text: That is not consistent with the lab results showing primary hypothyroidism; sepsis would present with high fever and hypotension, not isolated thyroid dysfunction. Your dry skin and lab values confirm Hashimoto's thyroiditis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hashimoto's Thyroiditis
